evidence: CheckBox 0x0060F1EB-0x0060F262 and RadioButton 0x0060D90B-0x0060D982 inline StringStruct::seek_pos(position), returning on failure. In particular F21D/D93D reject abs(position)>entry_count. An upper bound guard plus early Dialog::pos_to_id is not equivalent: pos_to_id retains a head ID on failed negative seek. Use existing seek_pos return value before height reads and pos_to_id at the later callback argument evaluation (CheckBox F36D).

After parent callback and sprite drawing, CheckBox F48F/F4A5/F4A8/F4AB and RadioButton DB98/DBAE/DBB1/DBB4 re-read current item and line count. A pre-callback payload cannot supply those reads if a callback changes the list. CheckBox F3AA and RadioButton DACA also re-read Dialog.field_64_ for copying after the callback. Retain original x/y and computed height but refresh mutable item/width. Current isolated bodies have provisional repairs; fresh compilation, exact matching and review remain required. No claim about observed runtime callback mutation or code acceptance is made.
payload.hypothesis: Use the real list seek result and preserve the original current-item read timing across callbacks. Saved geometry is not a license to cache mutable list payload or column width.
